rules.sentence: One of the causes of bowel obstruction is adhesions.
While, in some cases, the bowel obstruction caused by adhesions may spontaneously resolve, some patients may require surgery to lyse the adhesions.
It occurs in genetically susceptible individuals after an exaggerated immune response to a normal stimulus, such as food and intestinal flora.
Identify bloody diarrhea, tenesmus, and abdominal pain in the history of patients with inflammatory bowel disease.
